```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
data_ok <- requireNamespace("UbiPanTriage", quietly = TRUE) &&
  length(UbiPanTriage::available_cancers()) >= 33
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = data_ok)
```

# 简介 Introduction

`UbiPanTriage` 对用户基因集在 TCGA 癌种中计算四维评分：

- **泛素 Ubiquitin**：E1/E2/E3/DUB/UBD/ULD 功能层级分`r`n- **基础 Basic**：表达、差异、生存、ROC
- **免疫 Immune**：与免疫浸润的加权相关性
- **代谢 Metabolic**：与代谢途径的加权相关性

# 载入数据 Loading data

若尚未下载内置泛癌数据，请先运行一次：

```{r, eval = !data_ok}
# 数据未就绪时提示安装方法（跳过可视化示例）
message("Run UbiPanTriage::download_extdata() once to install the pan-cancer data (~4.2 GB), then re-knit.")
```

```{r, eval = data_ok}
if (data_ok) {
  library(UbiPanTriage)
  available_cancers()          # 查看可用癌种
  luad <- load_cancer_data("LUAD")
}
```



# 单癌种评分 Single-cancer scoring

```{r}
if (data_ok) {
  res <- score_genes(luad, c("MDM2", "TRIM44", "UBE2C", "FBXW7"))
  head(res$scores[, c("Gene", "Ubi_Score", "Basic_Score", "Immune_Score",
                      "Metabolic_Score", "Combined_Score", "Combined_Rank")])
}
```

# 修改权重 Adjusting weights

```{r}
if (data_ok) {
  bp <- default_basic_params()
  bp$weights <- c(expression = 1, diff = 1, survive = 2, roc = 1)  # 加重生存权重
  ip <- default_immune_params()
  ip$method <- "cibersort"                                          # 切换免疫方法
  cp <- default_combine_params()
  cp$method <- "weighted"                                           # 加权平均
  res2 <- score_genes(luad, c("MDM2", "TRIM44"), basic_params = bp,
                      immune_params = ip, combine_params = cp)
}
```

# 可视化 Visualization

```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
if (data_ok) {
  plot_radar(c(Basic = 0.8, Immune = 0.5, Metabolic = 0.6), gene = "MDM2")
  plot_immune_cor(luad, "MDM2", method = "timer")
  plot_metabolic_cor(luad, "MDM2")
  plot_expr_box(luad, "MDM2")
  plot_roc_diag(luad, "MDM2")
}
```

# 交互界面 Shiny app

```r
if (interactive() && data_ok) run_shiny_app()
```

# 自定义基因集 Custom gene sets

```r
if (data_ok) {
  # 读取用户基因（含可选特征分列）
  df <- read.csv("my_genes.csv")   # 第一列: 基因符号; 第二列(可选): 0-1 特征分
  genes <- as.character(df[[1]])
  feat  <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(df[[2]]), genes)
  cp <- default_combine_params()
  cp$include_feature <- TRUE
  cp$feature_scores <- feat
  res_custom <- score_genes(luad, genes, combine_params = cp)
}
```
